high_level_description: The image showcases a Seiko Dual Chime Oakwood Pendulum Clock, prominently displayed against a minimalist background. The clock is mounted on a wall and features a classic design with a wooden frame and a pendulum at the bottom. The pendulum has a golden bob, adding to the luxurious appearance of the clock. To the left of the clock, there is a modern pendant light fixture with a white, cylindrical shade, which complements the overall aesthetic of the scene. On the right side, part of a wire basket and a wooden surface are visible, suggesting a clean and organized space.
